title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Appoints Adam M. Jaworski as Chief Accounting Officer
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (InvenTrust or the Company), today announced the appointment of Adam M. Jaworski as Senior Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer, effective immediately. Mr. Jaworski joins InvenTrust with more than 20 years of real estate experience in financial and accounting leadership roles and brings a deep understanding of the real estate industry. He most recently served as Chief Accounting Officer of the United States platform of Global Logistic Properties (GLP), where he was instrumental in leading the predecessor companys initial public offering readiness efforts. We are pleased to welcome Adam to the InvenTrust leadership team, said Michael Podboy, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Investment Officer of InvenTrust.
